verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms an official Nitrokey Python SDK is published on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2), so the product ships its own SDK. But the evidence is a single resolution check, with no SDK documentation, examples or coverage details. The nitropy CLI and the NetHSM OpenAPI spec are adjacent tools, not SDKs. Missing for 10: documented SDK reference and guides, multi-language SDK coverage, evidence of API surface and stability (version 0.4.x), independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The official Python SDK also resolves on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2).
